questions.question: Fill in the blank: CSS stands for _____ Style Sheets.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: CSS stands for Cascading Style Sheets. The 'cascading' part refers to how styles flow down and inherit from parent elements.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: CSS stands for Cascading Style Sheets. The 'cascading' part refers to how styles flow down and inherit from parent elements.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: A class selector starts with a _____.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: Class selectors start with a dot (.). For example: .button selects all elements with class="button".

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: Class selectors start with a dot (.). For example: .button selects all elements with class="button".

questions.question: Fill in the blank: An ID selector starts with a _____.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: ID selectors start with a hash (#). For example: #header selects the element with id="header".

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: ID selectors start with a hash (#). For example: #header selects the element with id="header".

correct.details: CSS syntax is: selector { property: value; }. The value specifies what the property should be set to.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: To style all h1 elements, use _____.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: Element selectors use just the tag name: h1 { } selects all <h1> elements.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: Element selectors use just the tag name: h1 { } selects all <h1> elements.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: External CSS is written in a _____ file.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: External stylesheets are saved with the .css extension, like style.css.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: External stylesheets are saved with the .css extension, like style.css.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Inline CSS is added using the _____ attribute.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: Inline CSS uses the style attribute: <p style="color: red;">

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: Inline CSS uses the style attribute: <p style="color: red;">

questions.question: Fill in the blank: To style elements with class="highlight", use _____.

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: Class selectors use a dot: .highlight { } styles all elements with class="highlight".

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: Class selectors use a dot: .highlight { } styles all elements with class="highlight".
